title: Chest Item Saver
description: This mod lets you move chests without taking the items out, just like Shulker Boxes. It is great for moving your items to a new place.
body:
Chesto by Saduiiduo

This mod lets you move chests without taking the items out, just like Shulker Boxes. It is great for moving your items to a new place.

You can learn more about the mod in the video: [Mod Preview](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rLTHpAQECD0)
